title: Degree-0 integer multiplicity currents are finite weighted point sums on compactly contained sets
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and U, B ⊆ ℝ^P. Let R be a degree-0 IMRep in U representing S ∈ 𝒟_0(U), and suppose B ⊂⊂ U (closure B is compact and contained in U). Then there are N ∈ ℕ, w : ℕ → ℤ and x : ℕ → ℝ^P such that: x_l ∈ B and w_l ≠ 0 for every l < N; Σ_{l<N} |w_l| ≤ R.measure(B) in [0, ∞]; and S(ω) = Σ_{l<N} w_l ⟨ω(x_l)⟩ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^0(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ B. Here ⟨α⟩ := α(e) is the value of a 0-covector on the empty family e = (fun i => i.elim0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U B : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U 0) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), R.Represents S → CompactlyContained B U → ∃ (N : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℤ) (x : ℕ → Euclid P), (∀ l < N, x l ∈ B) ∧ (∀ l < N, w l ≠ 0) ∧ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range N, ((w l).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ R.measure B ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) ⊆ B → S ω = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N, (w l : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) (x l) (fun i => i.elim0)
